name: bug-fix
description: Narrow source diagnosis -> regression RED before production fix -> GREEN and existing verification -> two independent reviews with bounded repair -> exact final validation.
whenToUse: Repair a reported, source-confirmed defect with a regression test. Not for adding new features, speculative refactors or unreproducible reports.

phases.title: setup
phases.detail: Read manifests and exact existing verification commands; no execution

phases.title: analysis
phases.detail: Narrow source diagnosis, behavior contract and decision boundary

phases.title: code-loop
phases.detail: Regression RED -> fix GREEN -> independent reviews, at most three attempts

phases.title: validate
phases.detail: Fresh regression and verify runs, exact acceptance coverage
